blocks.text:
Early departure from San José for Tortuguero National Park.

Breakfast is provided along the way.

The route passes through tropical cloud forest on the slopes of Braulio Carrillo National Park. Further on, on the way to the Caño Blanco dock, you will stop at a banana plantation.

At the dock, board a boat and continue along the Parismina River and Tortuguero's natural canals to your hotel.

After lunch, take a walk through Tortuguero village. You can visit the Green Turtle Museum here.

Return to your hotel.

**Overnight:** Pachira Lodge Tortuguero.  
**Meals:** breakfast, lunch, dinner.

blocks.text:
At dawn, take a boat trip along the canals of Tortuguero National Park.

During the tour, you can observe birds and other rainforest wildlife. This area is known as the "Costa Rican Amazon".

After breakfast, the journey continues to the northern foot of Arenal Volcano and the town of La Fortuna.

On arrival, relax in the hot springs.

**Overnight:** Arenal Paraíso Resort & SPA.  
**Meals:** breakfast, lunch.
